stories.title: Microsoft Teams Desktop Client Fails to Load on Windows System – Microsoft Investigating
stories.description: Microsoft is investigating an ongoing issue causing some Windows users to face significant delays or outright failures when launching the Microsoft Teams desktop client.

stories.title: Thousands of OpenAI Agents Quietly Turned an Abandoned Wiki Into Their Coordination Channel
stories.description: Autonomous agents identifying as OpenAI systems used a German wiki to coordinate a timed web task and share a sandbox bypass.

stories.description: Attackers exploit two PaperCut flaws to steal credentials from U.S. and European education organizations.

stories.title: Microsoft Unveils Project Zenith Windows PCs That Can Run 30B+ AI Models Locally
stories.description: Microsoft has introduced Project Zenith, a new developer-optimized Windows 11 experience built for a class of high-memory PCs capable of running large AI models directly on-device, marking a significant shift away from cloud-dependent AI development workflows.

stories.title: In Other News: Microsoft’s Cloud Patches, Hacked Dropbox Accounts, Guardio’s $1.1B Valuation
stories.description: Noteworthy stories that might have slipped under the radar: Microsoft rolled out patches for cloud services, hackers compromised 5,000 Dropbox accounts, and Guardio is now valued at $1.1 billion.

stories.title: HPE Patches Critical RCE Vulnerabilities in AOS-CX
stories.description: Nearly two dozen issues, tracked collectively as CVE-2026-73749 (CVSS score of 9.8), were addressed with the updates.

stories.title: OpenAI Pledges $1 Billion to Bring Frontier AI to Critical Infrastructure Defenders
stories.description: The Daybreak initiative will provide subsidized AI cyber capabilities, training and technical assistance, though OpenAI has disclosed few details about costs and eligibility.

stories.title: Phishing Campaign Sends Millions of Emails Using Invisible Unicode to Evade Filters
stories.description: A phishing campaign sent up to 2.37 million weekday emails using invisible Unicode tags to split financial lure words and bypass filters.

stories.title: PostgreSQL Fixes 12-Year-Old Logical Decoding Flaw Enabling Replication-Role Code Execution
stories.description: PostgreSQL fixes CVE-2026-6471, which lets replication accounts load libraries and run code when logical WAL is enabled.

stories.title: Hackers Use Popular Messaging Services to Control New Windows Backdoors
stories.description: Toy Ghouls deploys custom Windows backdoors using messaging services to maintain control and evade detection.

stories.title: Sangoma Switchvox Vulnerabilities Exploited in the Wild
stories.description: Tracked as CVE-2026-9586, the unauthenticated SQL injection flaw can be exploited remotely for arbitrary code execution.

stories.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 400 Security Holes
stories.description: Microsoft today released updates to remedy at least 398 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software, including one weakness that is already being actively exploited and two others that were publicly detailed prior to today.
